items: Blanket campaigns pushed from headquarters often miss local preferences, while your reviews already show what guests love at each location.
AI feedback analysis can find the dishes, staff and experiences guests praise most at each store, so you know what to spotlight and where.
Build region-specific campaigns around those favorites and use guest wording from reviews in your ad copy.
Promoting what guests already love creates a flywheel: more people try it, more people review it, and the next campaign starts from stronger signals.
